name: Unitronics (1989) (RG) Ltd
summary: Unitronics (1989) (R'G) Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, produces, markets, and sells industrial automation products in Israel and internationally. It operates through, Products segment. The Products segment provides programmable logic controllers (PLCs), which are computer-based electronic products used for command and control of machines performing automated actions, including production systems and other automated installations in various areas. This segment offers various series of PLCs, as well as external expansion units for the PLCs; software for the PLCs; PLCs for management of automatic systems comprising industrial automation, logistics systems, and automated parking facilities, as well as for management of production floors; and additional auxiliary items. This segment serves manufacturers of PLC-controlled industrial machines in various industries consisting of plastics, textile, vehicle spare parts, food, petrochemical, and others. It serves customers in industrial and/or logistics businesses. Unitronics (1989) (R'G) Ltd was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Airport City, Israel.
